Aaditya Thackeray Responds to ₹500 Crore Defamation Notice

Aaditya Thackeray has rejected a ₹500 crore defamation notice sent by the father of Disha Salian. In a 25-page reply, Thackeray stated that a court order for a CBI probe did not name anyone as an accused. He argued that denial cannot be considered defamation.
